competences.description: Attacks the enemy to grant Silence for 1 turn with a 50% chance and block the target from removing harmful effects for 1 turn with a 30% chance.

effets.description: Skills with cooldowns will be locked. (Passive skills not included)

Harmful effects cannot be removed while this effect is on. This effect will be removed first when a harmful effect removal skill is used, and other harmful effects can be removed afterwards. Does not apply to bosses.

competences.description: Grants Immunity on all allies for 2 turns and creates a shield that's 20% of your MAX HP for 2 turns.

effets.description: The target will gain immunity against all harmful effects.
The Shield will absorb a fixed amount of damage.

competences.description: Attacks all enemies to stun for 1 turn and then silences them for 2 turns with a 70% chance. Decreases the skill cooldown time of [Magic Shock] by 1 turn if you don't get attacked during the enemy's turn.

effets.description: The target will be stunned and won't be able to attack.
Skills with cooldowns will be locked. (Passive skills not included)
Reduces cool down counter of skills by 1 or more
effets.note: If you don't get attacked during the enemy's turn
